verdict: No significant, material deterioration versus the baseline. The location and cause sections describe the background pattern of the (few) problem arrivals, not a new issue.

evidence: [F] 94% of late trains were already late at 7 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 18 Av: 13, on approach from 7 Av: 1, at or before Ditmas Av: 1, at or before 15 St-Prospect Park: 1. Largest time loss on segment 18 Av -> Ditmas Av (median +55s vs schedule).
[F] 70% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 7 Av.

[G] 100% of mildly late (>= 120s) trains were already late at 7 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at Fort Hamilton Pkwy: 10, at or before 7 Av: 3, at or before Fort Hamilton Pkwy: 3, at or before Church Av: 2. Largest time loss on segment Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy (median +175s vs schedule).
[G] 95% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 7 Av.
91% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 62%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
Weekend problem rate is 2.2x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
36% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 1.9x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 34% of delays on line(s) F, G (1.5x the system share) in the analysed months.
[G] 80% of the run-time loss sits on one segment (Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy, median +175s): a signal timer, speed restriction, or failure on that segment.
[F] Time is lost a little at every stop (18 Av -> Ditmas Av +55s, Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy +29s, 15 St-Prospect Park -> 7 Av +50s): a dwell-time / crowding pattern rather than one bad segment.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 170s on average vs 95s otherwise (1.8x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
Daily problem rate rises with wind (Spearman rho=0.81, p=0.005); adverse-weather days have 1.2x the problem rate.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 35% of delays on line(s) F, G (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
11% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'track' alert was active for the line (problem rate 28% with an alert vs 26% without, lift 1.0x).
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 16% of delays on line(s) F, G (0.7x the system share) in the analysed months.
4% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'signal' alert was active for the line (problem rate 28% with an alert vs 26% without, lift 1.0x).

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on F, G during the affected hours: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Inspect Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Dwell-time programme at 4 Av-9 St and the stops before it during the affected hours: platform controllers, door-closing announcements, step-back crews
recommendations.rationale: Run-time loss is spread across every stop on the approach, the signature of long dwells.
recommendations.expected_effect: Each stop recovers its excess dwell; the effect compounds along the line.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for F, G; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for F, G; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Check whether scheduled dwell and run times on the approach still match observed loads; re-time the schedule if not
recommendations.rationale: A schedule with unrealistic dwells makes every train late by design.

recommendations.action: Set a gap-filling rule: dispatch the next available train from Coney Island-Stillwell Av when a gap over 13 min forms
recommendations.rationale: A fifth of arrivals follow a large gap.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the longest waits, which dominate the APT metric.
